The name is believed to be auspicious, and girls with this name are often considered lucky and blessed. On social occasions and religious ceremonies, it is quite popular to exchange greetings and blessings to those named Nandni.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Nandni holds immense significance as it is associated with the blessings and grace of the goddess Lakshmi, the embodiment of wealth, fortune, and happiness. The name is believed to bestow luck, good fortune, and blessings of abundance on its bearer. Thus, Nandni is a name that not only sounds beautiful but also carries a profound spiritual meaning and significance.
